args.summary:
Cast-in-place continuous prestressed concrete box girder bridge, 4 spans (30+40+40+30 m), modeled as a 2D spine beam (MR-01) with system "continuous_on_piers" (MR-05) since pier column geometry was given.

Model summary:
- Girder: single-cell cast-in-place box, A = 8.45 m², I = 4.9374 m⁴ (integrated section, MR-02); C50 concrete Ec = 34500 MPa (JTG 3362-2018 3.1.5); owner-specified unit weight γ = 26.5 kN/m³ (MR-00 override); w = 223.925 kN/m, m = 22.826 t/m (MR-07). Self-weight of main girders only.
- Supports (0–4): Abutments 0 & 4 — PTFE sliding laminated elastomeric, 2 per line (S = 10.10, Kv = 3.142e6 kN/m, Kh = 0, longitudinal free); Pier 1 — plain laminated elastomeric fixed, 2 per line (S = 14.69, Kv = 8.029e6 kN/m, Kh = 10909 kN/m, longitudinal spring); Piers 2 & 3 — PTFE sliding, 2 per line (S = 13.54, Kv = 7.175e6 kN/m, Kh = 0). All via MR-03/MR-04 and JTG 3362-2018 8.7.
- Piers: twin circular columns D = 1.6 m, C40 (Ec = 32500 MPa), merged to single column (A = 4.0212 m², I = 0.6434 m⁴); heights 25/28/6 m, base fixed (MR-06).
- Live load: Highway Class I, one-way, 4 lanes; ξ = 0.67, qk = 10.5 kN/m; Pk = 320/340/340/320 kN per span; impact factor μ = 0.1864 from f1 = 3.1385 Hz (JTG D60-2015 4.3.2).

Key results: fundamental vertical frequency f1 = 3.139 Hz. Self-weight reactions ~2451/8658/9120/8686/2435 kN; max self-weight midspan moment 15.81 MN·m; live-load max positive moment 11.32 MN·m (span 2) and max negative moment −8.97 MN·m (support 2). All L1/L2/L3 checks passed.
